items.explain_en: Answer: a. A cone with \(r=5\), \(h=3\): \(V=\dfrac13\pi\cdot5^2\cdot3=25\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

items.explain_en: Answer: a. Arc length = base circumference: \(\dfrac{\pi l\alpha}{180}=2\pi r\Rightarrow\alpha=\dfrac{360r}{l}=120^\circ\).
